sar.narrative: This report concerns suspected fraudulent online activity on the account of customer C07297, involving card C07297-K1. On November 21, 2016, between 20:00:00 and 20:30:00, four unauthorized online transactions were conducted, totaling $1,906.07. The purchases occurred in billing regions 264 and 476. The perpetrator utilized at least two devices, including a Windows 7 desktop (Trident/7.0) and an iOS device. The activity is highly suspicious because the customer explicitly denied the final $482.12 charge, and the transaction amounts ($478.95, $456.96, $488.04, and $482.12) appear deliberately chosen to stay just under a $500 authorization threshold. Additionally, this card is typically used in person, with only 5 of 199 prior transactions occurring online. The transaction model scored the final transaction at 0.083 against a 2.1% base rate. Due to the coordinated nature of this abuse and the total exposure exceeding $1,000, a suspicious activity report is being filed.
